final_decision: Implemented Prompt658 by wrapping the previously committed Chrome Runner Bridge as a safe artifact-based browser_chatgpt_operator_adapter. The repo-side adapter creates browser request envelopes from Prompt657 analysis requests, validates response envelopes, normalizes valid ChatGPT JSON into analysis_artifact_v1, wraps raw non-JSON output as manual_review_required only, rejects wrong request ids and secret-like fields, and verifies Prompt657/Prompt655 compatibility without launching a browser or using network. The extension keeps the historical visible-DOM ChatGPT send/capture flow, documents provenance from d698389, defaults to localhost, and emits browser_chatgpt_response_envelope_v1 JSON.
